$comment: Size budgets for special data branches, owned by the health check (`special-branch-size`). Owner, 2026-10-05: special-branches.json is gone ("dont use /get rid of"), and the budgets live here, a file the HEALTH CHECK owns, not infrastructure (owner's choice 3 of 3; the alternatives were a `storage.budget` on each declaring directory, and declaring beans/todos storage now).
Names here are only what the check measures. A branch's NAME is the declaring directory's `storage` (or each script's built-in fallback); nothing else reads this file.
Each row is copied verbatim from the retired table, budget and basis included; the owner's words are in each `basis`.

budget.basis: Owner, 2026-10-04: "cat/cat-harness/qa-reports should have its own branch + limit", and chose 500 MB. Verdicts are commit-keyed and accumulate, so this is the number that says when the store needs pruning.

Owner, 2026-10-04, verbatim: "also update healthchecks for limits on the other specal branches (e.g. lean cache 4gb, auto-docs 1gb, beans 100mb, todos 100mb)"; asked per branch or for the whole family, they chose "Whole family". The family is what bounds a folio's clone, since a full clone fetches every cache branch.
